metaDescription: Kevin and James Li discuss what could follow an AI bubble pop, including AI nationalization, agent-first internet, regulation and trust.
summary: Kevin and guest James Li discuss what could happen if the AI bubble bursts. Li compares it to the dot-com crash, predicts China will be framed as the boogeyman and that AI may be nationalized by spring or summer, and expects the internet to become agent-first. Li says he does not think AI will kill everyone, arguing humans cause the problems. They discuss regulation and self-certification risks, open source, trust in institutions, and Kevin's claim that Peter Thiel is racing against time for mind uploading.
